name: Dragon
desc: Front-facing cartoon dragon with flapping ribbed wings, seeded horns and ember cracks — hovers on the beat, headbangs, soars figure-eights and torches the downbeat with a fire-breath cone.

act.doc: multi-minute dramaturgy (solo=obey pose; medley=cycle poses by section; siege=idle-soar-hover with firebreath on intense sections)
